definitions.gloss: observation deck; lookout point; viewing platform
definitions.explanation: A platform or area, usually at a high elevation, designed for people to enjoy a panoramic view. Found on tall buildings, mountains, and scenic spots.

examples.japanese: {展望台|てんぼうだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしかった→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: The view from the observation deck was wonderful.

examples.japanese: ⟦タワー→タワー：11035_tawaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{展望台|てんぼうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}って→上る：21460_noboru⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろした→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧。
examples.english: I went up to the tower's observation deck and looked down at the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よければ→いい：00118_ii⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{展望台|てんぼうだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: On a clear day, you can sometimes see Mt. Fuji from this observation deck.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧ (view, outlook) + {台|だい} (platform, stand). A staple of sightseeing in Japan, found at landmarks like Tokyo Tower, Tokyo Skytree, and mountain summits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展望台|てんぼうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧ (to go up to the observation deck)
- {展望台|てんぼうだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧ (the view from the observation deck)
- {展望台|てんぼうだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ (the observation deck is popular)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧: observation lobby — an enclosed viewing area
- ⟦{見晴|みは}らし→見晴らし：15713_miharashi⟧{台|だい}: lookout — a simpler, often outdoor viewpoint
